def test_remove_too_many():

        s.remove("gadget", 2)


def test_total_units():
    s = Stock()
    s.add("widget", 5)
    s.add("gadget", 3)
    s.add("widget", 2)
    s.remove("gadget", 1)
    assert s.total_units() == 9


def test_total_units_empty():
    assert Stock().total_units() == 0
